mutations.because: Scaling is the only thing `scaled` must do, so a mutant that returns its input unchanged must be caught: it would leave the proof test's 40 ms deadline at 40 ms instead of stretching it to 120 ms under a stubbed scale of 3, letting the helper give up too soon.
command: a wait helper allows its deadline times the scale before it gives up

mutations.because: Under CI with no numeric override the scale must be 3 to stretch handshake deadlines on a loaded runner; a mutant that returns 1 in the CI branch would leave those deadlines at their idle length, so the 3-under-CI case of the unit test must fail.
command: the wait scale is 3 under CI, 1 elsewhere, and the variable overrides both
